scope: CI packaging only; no runtime, authority, schema or production change

steps.baseline_run:
if [ -n "$DOCUMENT_BASE_SHA" ] && [ "$DOCUMENT_BASE_SHA" != "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]; then
  node scripts/docs/validate-document-metadata.mjs --base "$DOCUMENT_BASE_SHA"
else
  node scripts/docs/validate-document-metadata.mjs
fi

coverage.fallback: only explicit dispatch/local absent or initial push zero; malformed/missing required event context blocks

steps.baseline_run:
node scripts/persistence/validate-slice-p05-foundation.mjs
node scripts/persistence/validate-slice-p05-owner-decisions.mjs
node scripts/persistence/validate-slice-p05-schema-admission.mjs
node scripts/persistence/validate-first-physical-slice-readiness.mjs
node scripts/persistence/audit-first-physical-slice-readiness.mjs
node scripts/packaging/validate-apply-guards.mjs pins

corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@12.8.1 --activate
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

pnpm exec drizzle-kit check
pnpm db:verify-p05-generation

node scripts/persistence/validate-slice-p05-owner-decisions.mjs
node scripts/persistence/validate-slice-p05-schema-admission.mjs
pnpm validate:slice-p05
node scripts/persistence/validate-slice-p05-foundation.mjs
node scripts/persistence/validate-first-physical-slice-readiness.mjs
node scripts/persistence/audit-first-physical-slice-readiness.mjs
node scripts/packaging/validate-apply-guards.mjs pins

trigger_coverage.pull_request: all target branches, no path filters

measurement_status: planned structural counts; local and hosted measured results are separate evidence, never inferred from a green count
rollback: revert the complete consolidation commit (workflows, catalog, guards, tests and generated inventory together); create fresh exact-source receipts for the reverted tree
